facts.fact: Algerie Eco reports the national artificial intelligence strategy was adopted on Saturday 2024-12-07 in Algiers, announced at the close of the 3rd African Start-up Conference, with six axes and priority sectors of agriculture, health and industry.
Professor Merouane Debbah of the AI Scientific Council said public authorities have allocated a special budget (no amount given) to implement the strategy.

DZA.note: The advisory AI Scientific Council is not stated to carry out the strategy, so no body is recorded.
